subject: math
title: Story problems
parent_tip: Read each story aloud. Ask: do we get more or fewer? Then write the numbers, the + or − sign and the answer.

items.text: A box has 52 balls. Dad puts in 26 more. How many balls are in the box now?
A box has 62 apples. We take out 55. How many apples are in the box now?
A tank has 58 fish. We move 55 to a new tank. How many fish are in the first tank now?
